get.description: Open with a WebSocket upgrade; browsers cannot set headers on a WebSocket, so the login token goes in `token`. The server sends JSON text frames, each a `LiveMessage`: first one `LiveSnapshot` with the Run and all its steps, then a `LiveStepMessage` as each step starts or finishes and a `LiveStatus` when the Run changes status. It closes after the Run's final status; a Run that has already finished gets the snapshot and closes. Close codes: 4401 bad token, 4404 not this user's Run.
